releaseNotes: v2.1.0: Full Guide fix (all channels per category), EPG deep-fix with XMLTV + fuzzy matching, Live TV now-playing EPG pass-through, Account tab redesigned as clean server switcher (up to 10), complete D-pad navigation pass across all screens.
changelog: CRITICAL FIX: Guide was stuck at 5 channels — root cause was D-pad focus not auto-scrolling outside visible viewport. Added zapUp()/zapDown() in GuideViewModel + LaunchedEffect auto-scroll. All channels in selected category now fully navigable.
CRITICAL FIX: Guide layout height bug — channel column lacked fillMaxHeight() causing LazyColumn to get wrong height constraints. Fixed guide Row weight + column heights.

HIGH FIX: EPG coverage dramatically improved — switched from count-based threshold (>100) to time-based 4-hour TTL for XMLTV refresh. Threshold raised to >1000. On XMLTV failure falls back to batchShortEpg for ALL channels (not just 30).
HIGH FIX: EPG channel ID fuzzy matching — GuideViewModel now generates lowercase, no-suffix, .us and .uk variants of tvg-id for XMLTV lookup. Significantly increases EPG hit rate.
HIGH FIX: DVR storage picker moved from unreachable TopAppBar into Active tab content as a proper D-pad focusable card with onKeyEvent OK handler.

HIGH FIX: Account tab redesigned — removed raw credential form from 'My Accounts' tab. Now shows clean server switcher cards with active indicator and one-press Switch button. 'Manage Accounts' tab retains full add/edit/delete with limit raised to 10 accounts.
MEDIUM FIX: Live TV EPG now shows the currently AIRING show — checks startTimestamp <= now < stopTimestamp instead of blindly taking the first result.
MEDIUM FIX: Live TV channel list EPG loading is now viewport-based — removes the hard 100-channel cap. EPG loads as you scroll, only fetching channels not already cached.
MEDIUM FIX: SettingsViewModel account cap increased from 6 to 10.

_instructions.step1: Upload app-firestick-release.apk to Dropbox, get shareable link, change ?dl=0 to ?dl=1
_instructions.step2: Upload app-premium-release.apk to Dropbox, get shareable link, change ?dl=0 to ?dl=1
_instructions.step3: Replace YOUR_FIRESTICK_DROPBOX_LINK_HERE and YOUR_PREMIUM_DROPBOX_LINK_HERE in apkUrl fields
_instructions.step4: Paste the entire JSON into your Gist at https://gist.github.com/DYLANDOS_GITHUB_USERNAME/6056e65b41641393abf585cecbd92d07
_instructions.step5: The app auto-checks this Gist on launch and shows update banner when versionCode > installed code
